description: Golden evaluation dataset for RAGAS evaluation and retrieval benchmarking (50+ questions across 31 Tamil Nadu welfare schemes).

questions.question: What are the eligibility criteria for the Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme?
questions.scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme
questions.expected_ground_truth: Resident of Tamil Nadu; family member differently abled or annual income criteria met.

questions.question: What are the benefits under the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)?
questions.expected_ground_truth: Margin amount subsidy up to 35% for general and special categories.

questions.question: What is the unemployment allowance for differently abled persons in Tamil Nadu?
questions.expected_ground_truth: Monthly allowance paid based on disability percentage and educational status.
